scientific.integrity: The proof uses the printed enterprise-A equation, an exact geometric-Brownian-motion reduction on an invariant face, and the necessary vanishing of diffusion at a constant stochastic equilibrium. The source PDF and relevant stochastic-replicator literature were inspected directly. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result concerns the published stochastic equations and their probability interpretation. It does not identify undocumented simulation code or assert stability properties of a repaired stochastic model. The numerical escape probability is illustrative; the general noninvariance theorem is analytic.

title: The stochastic coalition model loses the probability cube and its claimed all-join equilibrium
